$comment: FROZEN canonical fixtures (M7 T0.5). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: MockProvider reads its scripted answers from here AND router tests assert `expectedRoute` against the same entries (no drift). DZ1-only — DZ2 has its own dz2/fixtures.json. Routing rule: a message goes to the LOCAL model when it contains PII (email/phone/card+Luhn/postal) OR a private-data intent (the answer will pull the user's own orders/profile, whose tool output must not leak to cloud). Clean public-catalog questions go to CLOUD. PII tokens chosen UNAMBIGUOUS so expectedRoute is stable when the real regex lands (T2.2).

queries.message: Do you have the Airpods Wireless Bluetooth Headphones in stock?
queries.reason: Clean public-catalog question, no PII and no private-data intent.
queries.mockAnswer: Yes — the Airpods Wireless Bluetooth Headphones are $89.99 and we have 3 in stock.

queries.message: What's the price of the Sony Playstation 4 Pro?
queries.mockAnswer: The Sony Playstation 4 Pro White Version is $399.99, with 10 in stock.

queries.message: Tell me about the Logitech gaming mouse.
queries.mockAnswer: The Logitech G-Series Gaming Mouse ($49.99) has six programmable buttons and LIGHTSYNC lighting. 7 in stock.

queries.message: My email is jane@example.com — can you resend my last receipt?
queries.reason: Contains an email address (PII) → must stay on the local model.
queries.mockAnswer: Hi Jane — I found your most recent order and re-sent the receipt to your email on file.

queries.message: My phone number is 415-555-0132, did my order ship yet?
queries.reason: Contains a phone number (PII) plus a private-order intent → local.
queries.mockAnswer: Your most recent order is paid and is being prepared for shipment.

queries.message: Is the card 4111 1111 1111 1111 the one saved on my account?
queries.reason: Contains a Luhn-valid credit-card number (PII) → local.
queries.mockAnswer: For your security I don't display saved card numbers, but I can confirm your profile is set up.

queries.reason: Private-data intent: answering requires the user's own orders; tool output must not leak to cloud.
queries.mockAnswer: Your latest order is paid and not yet delivered. I'll keep an eye on it for you.

queries.message: What's the email address on my profile?
queries.reason: Private-data intent: pulls the user's own profile; PII in the tool output must stay local.
queries.mockAnswer: The email on your profile is the one you used to sign in. Want me to update it?
